_readme:
Certifications and credentials. Entries show on the home page and on /certifications, where visitors can filter them by skill. The home section and the nav link hide themselves while `items` is empty; /certifications shows `emptyMessage` instead. Copy this shape into `items`:

{
  "id": "aws-saa",
  "name": "AWS Certified Solutions Architect · Associate",
  "issuer": "Amazon Web Services",
  "issued": "2026-03",
  "expires": "2029-03",
  "credentialId": "ABCD-1234-EFGH",
  "verifyUrl": "https://www.credly.com/badges/...",
  "image": "/certifications/aws-saa.webp",
  "imageAlt": "AWS Solutions Architect Associate badge",
  "skills": ["AWS", "Architecture"]
}

Every field except id, name, issuer and issued is optional. Set `expires` to null for credentials that do not lapse, and leave it out when you do not know, so the card makes no claim either way. `verifyUrl` is what turns the entry into something an employer can check, so add it whenever the issuer publishes one. `image` must exist under ./public or it is dropped and the card renders without a badge; put the original badge in assets/certifications and run `npm run images` to get the .webp.

heading: Credentials and recognition.
blurb: Qualifications and competition results, with the issuer's verification link wherever one exists.
emptyMessage: No credentials listed yet. They appear here as each one is verified.
